notes: Census reconciles KHII and KHIIFM ordinary-enemy and boss category pages, then reads individual stat and Journal tables. KHIIFM overrides replace original KHII sibling tables; shared KHII tables without FM alternatives are retained and labeled. Contexts retain episode, cup, body-part and Data-rematch differences. Page groups and Journal entries have different denominators. Journal prose is not reproduced. Damage multipliers are incoming-damage factors, not equipment resistance percentages.
